## Review and Adopt Agenda

## Motion :

Larry Marx motions to adopt agenda. Jamie Alley seconds motion. Agenda is adopted.

## Review and Adopt Minutes Motion :

Jamie Alley motions to approve the minutes from 1/19/25. Elizabeth Huntley seconds motion. Minutes are approved.

## Grant Application Update

J. Thomas - PA Compact will be applying for FSMB Foundation Grant Category 3 Grant which is for license portability, including funding technology for the adoption and operation of the PA Compact. The grant is for up to $15,000. This application is due on March 28 and recipients will be announced by April 18. https://www.fsmb.org/foundation/grant-opportunities/

## MOU Update

MOUs between PA commission, NCCPA, AAPA and CSG are out for signatures through DocuSign. Currently with CSG finance. $150,000 from each NCCPA and AAPA. CSG will hold funds and keep records and will transfer to knew secretariat once one is hired.

## Draft Budget Update

L. Marx - Will we have more information by mid-April to add to draft budget?

- C. Sims- Commission may not have funds by then, depends how long transfer would take.
- J. Thomas- Commission should have MOUs which could be added to revenue portion of budget, CSG could provide specifics on secretariat, legal and executive director costs to specify in budget.

Suggestion for Finance Committee to meet before full commission meeting to update draft budget.
